articles.summary: ARLINGTON, Va. --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Feb. 25, 2026-- Graham Holdings Company (NYSE: GHC) today reported its financial results for the fourth quarter and full year of 2025. The Company also filed its Form 10-K today for the year ended December 31, 2025 with the Securities and Exchange Commission.
articles.title: Graham Holdings Company Reports 2025 and Fourth Quarter Earnings

articles.summary: ARLINGTON, Va. --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Feb. 24, 2026-- Graham Holdings Company (NYSE: GHC) today declared a regular quarterly dividend of $1.88 per share, payable on May 7, 2026, to shareholders of record on April 16, 2026. View source version on businesswire.com:
articles.title: Graham Holdings Company Declares Regular Quarterly Dividend
